dedupe_keys.name: bentley openpaths emme with cube and cityphi transportation planning and modelling software

description: EMME is a multimodal transport planning and travel demand modelling package now sold by Bentley Systems as part of Bentley OpenPaths, which also includes CUBE and the CityPhi visualisation tool. It is used to build models of cities and regions across public transport, road and multimodal networks, apply trip-, tour- or activity-based travel demand models to evaluate policies, infrastructure and mobility demand, and combine network models with demand forecasts, with automated calibration, data fusion and analytics. The higher tier adds advanced demand modelling, traffic simulation and dynamic traffic assignment. It is generic and used for any city, region or country. It is commercial software sold by annual subscription, with the Advanced tier starting at 9,951 US dollars and the Ultimate tier at 12,877 US dollars for a 12-month licence, including credits for training or expert services. Caveats: the software is closed and its results depend on the model built by the user and its calibration data. It supports network flow and capacity planning studies, including scenario tests of network disruptions or new infrastructure in regional transport models. It is related to MATSim and SUMO as open alternatives and complements the Aimsun Next traffic simulator.
name: Bentley OpenPaths EMME (with CUBE and CityPhi), transportation planning and modelling software
